title: The drop runner sees rasters and converted layers on the map, and takes an empty answers list
why: Rehearsal 2 run 2 (docs/evidence/step-9/s9-2/result-b.json) had frames.mapCaptures 0: only import packages were witnessed on the map

changes.studio: useSurfaceLayer returns drawn, the item ids with a surface part handed to the scene; MapWorkspace and WindowedArea set data-drawn-items beside data-drawn-packages, with no visible words
runner: an on_map raster or point cloud with read parts and no package is witnessed on the batch area (a package's area, else the one area of the case's site) once data-drawn-items lists it; lastPartOnMap once partsDone equals partsPlanned
a loose root item whose source the kit original's omissions read names as a converted layer is a member named <original> derived <ordinal>, observed and witnessed like any member
an answers file with an empty answers list is valid in both readers; every other check stays

limits: data-drawn-items lists parts handed to the scene engine; the engine adds queued parts one per frame and has no public read of drawn surface parts, so the runner's two-frame wait is the margin
a site with several areas and no package gives no batch area, so the item is not witnessed rather than guessed
not yet proved on a rehearsal runtime
